summary.text: Daniel Johnston is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 24 (Kathryn) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Daniel Johnston's service as "House 2017-2020; since 2025". The member page lists Daniel Johnston's committee assignments as including the Judiciary and the Transportation standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Daniel Johnston's occupation as Small Business Owner.
It lists education as BA, Interdisciplinary Studies, Accounting/Religion; MA, Public Policy-Public Administration.
It lists military service as Army, retired.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: VFW Post #2764; DAV Post #24; NRA; Eagles Post #2192.
Daniel Johnston is listed as married to Wendi with 8 children.
